senses.gloss: † जट् जट्, i. 1, Par. To be entangled.

जट जट,
 I. m. = f. (see
 II.), Hariv. 9551.
 II. f. टा,
 1. The hair matted, as worn by the god Śiva and by ascetics; the long hair occasionally clotted together and brought over the head, so as to project like a horn from the forehead, or allowed to fall carelessly over the back and shoulders, Man. 6, 6.
 2. A braid, MBh. 3, 16137.
 --Comp.
जटाजिनिन् जटाजिनिन्, i. e. जटा-अजिन + इन्, adj. Wearing matted hair and the hide of an antelope, MBh. 1, 4917.
जटायु जटायु and जटायुस् जटायुस्, m. A fabulous vulture, Rām. 1, 1, 51.
जटाल जटा + ल, and जटालक जटाल + क, adj., f. ला, इका, Wearing matted hair, Hariv. 10594; Mārk. P. 8, 176.
जटिन् जटिन्, i. e. जटा + इन्, adj. Wearing matted hair, Man. 11, 92.

जटिल जटिल, i. e. जटा + इल,
 I. adj., f. ला.
 1. Having matted or entangled hair, Man. 2, 219; MBh. 3, 16257.
 2. Entangled, Bhāg. P. 3, 33, 14.
 II. f. ला.
 1. A proper name, MBh. 1, 7265.
 2. The name of several plants, e. g. Suśr. 1, 71, 16.
जटिलीभाव जटिलीभाव, i. e. जटिल-भू + अ, m. Clotting, Suśr. 1, 272, 2.
जाटासुरि जाटासुरि, i. e. जटासुर (the name of a demon), + इ, patronym., MBh. 7, 7856.
जटा- + धर जटा- + धर, 1. adj. wearing matted hair (cf. जटा) Rām. 2, 86, 22; an ascetic, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 7. 2. epithet of Śiva, MBh. 3, 1625.
जटा- + धारिन् जटा- + धारिन्, adj. wearing matted hair (see जटा), Bhāg. P. 4, 2, 29.
